steps.title: Starting out
steps.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz in the Burgh de Rott pub basement.

actions.text: Is there something I can do to help out?

steps.text: [Accept Quest]
Continue speaking to Veliaf Hurtz.

actions.text: What is the Sanguinesti region?
How can I search for the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque?
Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti Myreque?
Tell me again how I get into the Sanguinesti region.

steps.text: Search the chest to the north for garlic.
Exit the pub basement.

steps.title: The ruined Icyene city
steps.text: Search the boat in the boathouse to the south-east.
Use a plank on it to fix it.
Use a plank on the boat chute to fix it.
Push the boat down the chute.
Board the boat.
Exit the boat, kick down the floor, and climb down.
steps.warning: Manually click Freedom if a Vyrewatch stops you.

steps.text: Climb the wall rubble.
Talk to a Meiyerditch citizen.

actions.text: (whisper) Do you know about the Myreque?
(whisper) I really need to meet the Myreque.
How can Old Man Ral help me?

steps.text:
Talk to Old Man Ral (Achievement icon on the map).
  • (Optional) If you want to reduce detection chance by the Vyrewatch, you can buy a set of Vyrewatch clothing from Trader Sven just south of Old Man Ral before continuing.

actions.text: Someone said you could help me.
Old Man Ral, the sage of Sanguinesti.

steps.text: Go to the building to the west-southwest of Old Man Ral and climb the ladder.

steps.title: Navigating Meiyerditch
steps.text: Jump to the floorboards in the south, then to the east.
Push the wall.
Walk-across the floor.
Crawl-under the wall to the north.
Push the wall.
Walk-across the floor.
Climb-down the ladder.

steps.title: Navigating Meiyerditch
steps.text: Follow the path.
Search the table next to the wall.
Open the trapdoor table.
Climb-into the trapdoor tunnel.
Climb-up the shelf next to the sickle logo in the north-west corner of the room.
Crawl-under the wall, jump-to the floorboards and climb-down the ladder.
Search the pots.
Open the door.

steps.title: Sector 2 directions
steps.text: Climb up the ladder in the room to the east, by the sickle.
Climb up the shelf at the end of the path.
Climb up the ladder.
Climb down the ladder at the end of the path.
Follow the path and climb down the ladder.
Climb up the shelf at the end of the path.
Climb down the shelf to the north-east.
Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Search the wall to the west to get the ladder top.
Climb down the ladder.
Repair the broken ladder.
Climb down the ladder.

steps.title: Sector 3 directions
steps.text: Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Jump to the floorboards in the east and climb down the stairs.
Push the wall.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Open the lumpy rug.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.

steps.title: Myreque meetings
steps.text: Talk to Vertida Sefalatis.

actions.text: What should I do now?

steps.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz, back in the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott.

actions.text: I have a message for you from Vertida!
What do you want me to do?

steps.title: Ambush at Paterdomus
steps.text:
Talk to Drezel in the Mausoleum under the Paterdomus temple west of Canifis.
  • Use CKS or the invitation box to teleport nearby.

actions.text: Talk about something else.
Did you hear the sounds as well?

postconditions.text: let me know if you find something

steps.text: Take the west exit, past the monuments.
Search the small bush slightly south of the western church steps.
Talk to Drezel in the Mausoleum.

actions.text: Talk about something else.

steps.text:
Talk to King Roald in the Varrock Palace.
  • You will be teleported back to the Paterdomus.

actions.text: Talk about Darkness of Hallowvale.
What should I do now?
Yes thanks, I'll accept the free teleport.

steps.title: Meeting Safalaan Hallow
steps.text: Talk to Drezel about what to do next.

actions.text: Talk about something else.
What should I do now?

steps.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz back in the basement of the pub in Burgh de Rott.

actions.text: I was attacked near to Paterdomus!
King Roald cannot send troops!
What should we do now?

steps.text: Exit the pub basement.
Board the boat to the south-east.
Get caught by a Vyrewatch.

actions.text: Send me to the mines! (Do a bit of menial work)

steps.text: Mine 15 ore from the walls.
Use them on a minecart

actions.text: Yes, I'll place it all in the cart.

steps.text: Talk to a guard.
Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the stairs at the end of the path.
Push the wall.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Open the lumpy rug.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.

Talk to Vertida
  • You will be teleported back to sector 1.

actions.text: What should I do now?
Okay, lead the way.

steps.text: Climb down the ladder.
Climb over the wall rubble near the shore.
Climb the fallen floor.
Follow the path.
Choose the 'search' option on the rocky surface.
Climb up the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb the ladder to the north.
Climb down the ladder to the north.
Climb up the ladder at the end of the path.
Talk to Safalaan to the north.

actions.text: I was attacked near Paterdomus on my travels.
Can I help in some way?

steps.text: Run along the wall and stand on the sickle on the ground.
Use the papyrus on the charcoal and watch the cutscene.
Use papyrus on charcoal at the next spot.
Use papyrus on charcoal at the last spot.

Watch cutscene. Let Vanstrom attack you a bit which will knock you out.
  • Talk to and finish the dialogue with Sarius if she didn't automatically talk to you when Vanstrom knocked you out.

postconditions.text: why else would you be here

steps.text: Finish the final sketch.
Go south back to the ladder and climb down.
Get caught by a Vyrewatch.

actions.text: Send me to the mines! (Do a bit of menial work)

steps.text: Mine 15 ore from the walls.
Use them on a minecart

actions.text: Yes, I'll place it all in the cart.

steps.text: Talk to a guard.
Climb the ladder at the end of the path.
Climb down the stairs at the end of the path.
Push the wall.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Open the lumpy rug.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.
Talk to Safalaan.

actions.text: I have all the sketches for you!
What should I do now?

postconditions.text: you could get a hold of it

steps.title: Locating the laboratory
steps.text: Leave the hideout.
Push the wall and climb the stairs.
Climb down the ladder.
Look at the fireplace to the south.
Read the message.
steps.warning: There isn't tracking for this step currently.

steps.text: Search the portrait and slash it with the knife.
Search the portrait again to pick up a large ornate key.
Talk to Safalaan in the base and give him the message.

actions.text: I have a message for you Safalaan - it may be important.

postconditions.text: you look into this for us

steps.text: Push the wall and climb the stairs.
Climb down the ladder.
Follow the path to the house with the tapestry.
Look-at the tapestry and slash it with a knife.
Walk-through the slashed tapestry.
Use the large ornate key on the vampyre statue.
Climb-down the staircase.

Use telekinetic grab on Haemalchemy (Vol. 1).
  • Runes can be found by searching the broken rune case.

steps.title: Finishing up
steps.text: Climb-up the staircase.
Head back to the Meiyerditch Myreque base.
Climb down the stairs at the end of the path.
Push the wall.
Push the decorated wall from the southern side.
Open the lumpy rug.
Climb down trapdoor to enter the hideout.
Speak to Safalaan.
Take the sealed message to Veliaf in the Burgh de Rott cellar.

actions.text: I have a message for you from Safalaan.
